protocol.targets: Mature incremental platform and merchant contribution. Independent regressors; no implicit cross-objective MSE weighting.
protocol.method: Backward fitted Q for three decision stages; gamma=1 is the undiscounted finite-horizon total. Gamma=0 is the myopic control.
protocol.constraints: Each action must have predicted merchant continuation at least as high as the wait action. Frozen executor retains its hard limits.

limits: Partial-observation history approximation; no Markov or convergence guarantee.
Estimated values are not calibrated confidence bounds or proof of profit.
All training markets are development only; no current validation future is an input.
